losses.message: The expected floor opening identity cannot be created under the current scope because CHANGE_SCOPE only authorizes 'opening-second-floor-stair-void'. No update to second-floor-slab or opening attributes can make the deterministic gate recognize the missing identity.

missing_facts.message: The deterministic geometry gate requires the floor opening with stable id 'opening-second-floor-slab-stair', but the current scoped entity is 'opening-second-floor-stair-void'. CHANGE_SCOPE.entity_ids does not authorize adding, removing, or renaming to the expected id, so no safe ChangeSet can repair this identity mismatch.
